## Reuse HTML saved last week

Only looks at rows whose slide folder still has no carousel_post<N>.html.
For each one it looks for an old-style folder
(surname_title_variant_driveid, with or without a number prefix) that
contains an .html file, and checks that it comes from the SAME run as the
slides in the folder now.

**Status per row**
verified_same_run: the old folder's slide JPGs are byte-identical to the
  current ones. Safe, and copied.
different_run: an older version of this post. Skipped.
unverified_close / unverified_far: the old folder has no JPGs to compare,
  so it goes by when the HTML was saved versus generated_at (MAX_HOURS).
  Skipped unless COPY_UNVERIFIED_CLOSE is on.
no_old_html_found: nothing usable; this post needs a re-run.

**Settings**
OLD_HTML_ROOTS: folder(s) holding last week's folders, as n8n sees them,
  comma-separated (searched 3 levels deep)
SLIDES_ROOT: same as in the placement workflow
Leave DRY_RUN on first. The report goes to
REPORT_DIR/old_html_match_report.json.
